evidence_basis: The evidence supports near-term two-sided uncertainty: deterioration and deleveraging argue against uninterrupted continuation, while persistent ETH/BTC support, positive 24-hour returns, and non-extreme sentiment argue against assuming a confirmed breakdown. A bounded range better preserves this disagreement than a strong directional forecast.
